name: Companhia Energetica do Ceara - Coelce
summary: Companhia Energética do Ceará - Coelce engages in the distribution of electricity. It operates in 184 municipalities in the state of Ceará in Brazil. The company is based in Fortaleza, Brazil. Companhia Energética do Ceará - Coelce is a subsidiary of Enel Brasil S.A.
